title: 新闻中的数字与单位
goal: 听辨新闻中的数字并将数值对应到对象及单位。

points.label: 将数值对应到对象及单位

sources.title: 全国大学英语四、六级考试大纲（2016年修订版）

body.p: 新闻里的数字要和对象、单位、时间对应起来。同一个数字配上不同的单位，意思就不同。

body.box: The trip takes fifteen minutes and costs fifteen dollars.

body.p: fifteen minutes 表示时长，fifteen dollars 表示费用。变化前后的两个数值要分开记。

cards.title: 数字对比
rows: Thirteen seats remain; thirty were available.
Fourteen tickets were sold; forty were printed.
A hundred visited today; a thousand visited this month.
Two hundred seats were filled out of two thousand.
Three hundred maps were used out of three thousand.

cards.title: 比例与日期
rows: Ten percent walked; twenty percent cycled.
Fifteen percent arrived early; fifty percent arrived later.
Thirty percent chose tea; thirteen percent chose juice.
The work starts on March fifth and ends on May third.
The hall closes on June tenth and opens on June twentieth.
Tickets arrive on July first; sales begin on July fifteenth.

cards.title: 年龄与单位
rows: A thirteen-year-old visitor met a thirty-year-old guide.
The fourteen-year-old student spoke to a forty-year-old teacher.
A fifteen-year-old musician joined a fifty-year-old director.
from 后是原值，to 后是新值。
Attendance rose from twenty to thirty.

lines.text: Thirteen students joined the garden project, and thirty attended its opening.

items.stem: How many students joined the project?
items.why: 依据是 Thirteen students joined the garden project。第二项符合；thirty 是参加开幕的人数。

lines.text: The hall closes on June tenth and reopens on June twentieth.

items.why: 依据是 reopens on June twentieth。第三项符合；June tenth 是关闭的日期。

lines.text: The tour takes twenty minutes and costs fifteen dollars.

items.why: 依据是 costs fifteen dollars。fifteen 后面的单位是 dollars，指价格，第四项符合。

lines.text: Attendance rose from two hundred to three hundred last month.

items.stem: What was the new attendance figure?
items.why: 依据是 rose from two hundred to three hundred。to 后面是变化后的数值，第一项符合。

lines.text: A town museum has extended its weekend opening hours after receiving comments from visitors. The museum now opens at nine on Saturday instead of ten. On Sunday it continues to open at ten, but it closes at six rather than five. Last month, three hundred people visited on Saturdays, compared with two hundred during the previous month. A museum officer said the longer hours would give families more time to see the displays. The museum has also introduced a short tour of the building. The tour lasts forty minutes and costs fifteen dollars per adult. Children can join without a charge when accompanied by an adult. The museum plans to review attendance at the end of the season. Staff will keep a record of visitor numbers and ask people whether the revised hours are useful. The officer said weekday opening times and the existing bus stop outside the building would remain unchanged.

items.stem: How long does the new tour last?
items.why: 依据是 The tour lasts forty minutes。第二项符合；fifteen 是成人票价。

items.stem: What was the earlier Saturday attendance figure?
items.why: 依据是 compared with two hundred during the previous month。这是变化前的人数，第三项符合。

lines.text: Thirteen volunteers planted trees on Saturday. Thirty more will help next week.

items.stem: How many volunteers planted trees on Saturday?
items.why: 依据是 Thirteen volunteers planted trees on Saturday。第三项符合；thirty 是下周来帮忙的人数。

lines.text: The exhibition opens on March fifth and closes on May third.

items.why: 依据是 opens on March fifth。第一项符合；May third 是闭展日期。

lines.text: The library received two thousand books this year. Two hundred arrived in May.

items.stem: How many books arrived in May?
items.why: 依据是 Two hundred arrived in May。第四项符合；two thousand 是全年收到的总数。

lines.text: Fifteen percent of visitors chose the morning tour, while fifty percent chose the afternoon tour.

items.stem: What percentage chose the morning tour?
items.why: 依据是 Fifteen percent of visitors chose the morning tour。第二项符合；fifty percent 选的是下午的参观。

lines.text: A fourteen-year-old student interviewed a forty-year-old gardener for the project.

items.why: 依据是 A fourteen-year-old student。第三项符合；forty 是园丁的年龄。

lines.text: The boat journey lasts thirty minutes and costs twenty dollars.

items.why: 依据是 costs twenty dollars。twenty 后面的单位是 dollars，指费用，第一项符合。

lines.text: The class had twelve students last month and now has twenty students.

items.stem: What is the current class size?
items.why: 依据是 now has twenty students。第四项符合；twelve 是上个月的人数。

lines.text: The hall rental is fifty dollars, and the meeting lasts fifty minutes.

items.stem: Which figure describes the duration of the meeting?
items.why: 依据是 the meeting lasts fifty minutes。minutes 表示时长，第二项符合；fifty dollars 是场地租金。
